text:
emma: Quick sync — I'm proposing an audit-event schema update to introduce event_version (int) and add fields: request_client_id, kms_key_id, auth_method. Also want to deprecate actor_ip and session_id (both moved to legacy). Need to decide versioning semantics and customer-facing validation.

raj: +1 on explicit event_version. Do we do semantic versioning (v2.1) or integer monotonic? I'd vote monotonic int (1,2,3) for easier comparisons in routing and fallbacks.

mike: Agree integer. Also: how do we handle mixed-version events in the same customer export? We should include event_version in the top-level envelope so downstream validators can short-circuit.

olivia: For KMS integration — adding kms_key_id is fine but we need to ensure we don't leak internal ARNs to customers. Suggest storing a masked token for customer-facing exports and full id in internal-only logs.

emma: Good call. Proposed compatibility rules:
- event_version increases when any top-level field is added/removed or when field semantics change
- minor non-breaking additions (new optional metadata) do NOT bump event_version only a schema_revision string
- servers should accept older versions for 90 days before rejecting

raj: How about rollout plan? Canary in internal-only export, then opt-in customers for 2 weeks, then gradual enforcement. Need a migration playbook.

mike: Migration checklist (draft):
1) runtime accepts vN and vN+1
2) exporters tag events with event_version
3) validator lib released (py/ts) with strict mode behind flag
4) integration test suite and sample datasets
5) customer communication + validation endpoint

olivia: Customer-facing validation: provide a /validate-audit-event endpoint that returns:
- PASS or list of warnings/errors
- suggested remediation and example transformed payload
Also add a webhook they can POST a sample event to for quick checks.

audit-bot: Deploy plan created: canary-internal -> opt-in customers -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1234

emma: Security note — RBAC change required: read/export role must be able to see masked kms_key_id but not full. We'll need an RBAC migration ticket.

raj: Also vuln triage: if we remove actor_ip, the data retention policies must retain it for X days for incident response. Otherwise runbook updates needed.

mike: Action items:
- emma -> write schema diff and compatibility doc (due EOD Wed)
- raj -> draft RBAC migration + retention exceptions (due Thu)
- olivia -> design masked customer export format and validate KMS leakage (due Thu)
- mike -> prepare validator libs and integration tests (PR by next Tue)

emma: I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri 10am to finalize rollout windows. @raj @mike @olivia please add blockers to the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/audit/schema-migration

olivia: quick question — for signing/attribution, we plan to keep event_signature (HMAC) using key versioning. Make sure signature covers canonicalized payload and event_version.

emma: yes, include key_version in signature metadata. Ok folks — thanks. :thumbsup:
